description: This file defines the ResetPasswordViewModel class used for handling user input for resetting passwords in the web application's account view model layer.

classes.name: ResetPasswordViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that encapsulates the data required for resetting a user's password, including email, new password, confirmation, and a reset code.

methods.name: setter for Email
methods.description: Sets the email address for the password reset request.

methods.name: setter for Password
methods.description: Sets the new password for the account.

methods.name: setter for ConfirmPassword
methods.description: Sets the confirmation of the new password.

methods.name: setter for Code
methods.description: Sets the reset code associated with the password reset process.
